title: Water lily drifts

source.source_title: [Amateur film: Wathen collection: New York World's Fair, 1939-40] (Part I)
source.why_this_clip: A pink water lily seen from above fills the middle of the frame and drifts slightly on the water, its petals turning a little. The interval starts after the cut at 3.75 s from the white lily shot and runs to the end of the clip.

source_selection.evidence: Builder inspected16raw source samples spanning the retained interval and boundary margins in preflight-source.jpg. One continuous event; no internal cut/dissolve observed.
